ideas.name: Treasury Auction Price Cycle
ideas.claim: Two-year Treasury note yields peaked on auction day and were lower before and after it.
ideas.quote: Two-year note yields peaked on auction day and sat below that level both before and after.
ideas.mechanism: Auction-related Treasury supply and price pressure

rules.timeframe: Five days before and five days after the auction

ideas.claimed_result: The page reports an 8.62 basis-point ten-day strategy P&L and a Sharpe ratio of 1.08 for January 1980 through June 2008. It also reports that a 2025 study found no pre-auction trend.
required_data: US two-year Treasury note prices or yields
